headline: Sin configuración activa de crisis; vigilancia estructural normal
summary: El detector no identifica actualmente una configuración de crisis de deuda/dólar ni estrés material de NOK.
reasons: Ningún bloque operativo supera sus umbrales de vigilancia

values.method: Severity is max(S&P 500 decline, VIX level); the gate requires an equity fall or a high and rising VIX. A high but falling VIX does not open the gate.

nks.note: Brent and VIX are not added again when a residual series is supplied; doing so would double count them.

nrs.note: USD/NOK is deliberately excluded from the reversal gate.
nrs.score_semantics: gate_score is descriptive gate completion; operational_score is zero unless the full NRS confirmation state is reached.

current.method_note: URP and DSS are mutually diagnostic, not mutually exclusive scores. NRS is only confirmed when the NOK residual is available and negative.
current.method_note_v041: URP requires a fresh risk-off onset. NKS and NRS use a walk-forward Huber residual of EUR/NOK against EUR/SEK, Brent and VIX. Every score at t is fitted and standardised only with information available before t. NRS gate completion is reported separately from its operational alert.
